svg.title: Blister deformation, interface fracture and dissipation
svg.desc: A bubble pressure moves a layer with thickness hf and deflection w. Its crack edge has local GI and GII, and toughness Gc differs from pressure. Area A controls a necessary work budget; gel viscosity dissipates motion.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A pressure load must become an interface energy release

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 压力载荷必须转化为界面能量释放
